application: scripts/depthn_screen_amended_verdict.py (the gate, before any interval) and scripts/depthn_extension_dispatch.py (refusal)
computed_before: Only the screen latency rule (CONTINUE), the fairness checkpoints (flags 1 and 2, acknowledged benign) and descriptive re-stratifications of Foul Play's iteration rates had been computed; none carries outcomes. No paired, score or outcome statistic of this run had been computed.
decided_by: the lead (search, V2, CUDA), after two benign acknowledgements (flag 1 at 200 pairs, -5.0%; flag 2, drift, -13.75% in its window) left the declared online monitor's re-arm threshold at 16.25%

rule.final_fairness_gate: at the screen's end, and again at 2,000 if extended: the finer-stratified weighted ratio of Foul Play's iterations_per_budget_second, search over RAW, over the WHOLE run (not a window), with cells budget stratum x turn band x our alive bucket x their alive bucket (1-2, 3-4, 5-6), the declared sparse-cell merge and fairness.reading's weights; if |difference| > 5% the result is VOID_FAIRNESS. The amended verdict checks it before any interval; the extension dispatcher refuses on it
rule.online_monitor: unchanged: the declared checkpoints, thresholds and acknowledgements continue; the final gate certifies the run
rule.process_age_check: descriptive (Foul Play rates only, no outcomes): within the finer cells, Foul Play's rate against seconds since its game's start (bucketed), per arm, and the arm ratio with age buckets added to the stratification; reported in the readout. If the age-controlled ratio is beyond 5% while the position-only one is within, it is reported to the lead; the extension may still dispatch when the final gate passes
